label: Two ways to describe a region
section: Two ways to describe a region
subgoals: Describe the same region in type II limits

visual.title: The same cells, read the other way
visual.caption: The same shaded region can be described with x first or y first. The reversed bounds are printed beside the original, and the two describe exactly the same cells.

predict.question: With y fixed first, what are the x-limits of this region?
predict.explain: From y = x² and y = x, for a fixed y in [0, 1] the x values run from y up to √y.
